evaluator_provenance.note: Every receipt is bound to its own artifact preflight. Different evaluator payload/pipeline hashes are preserved; their cause is not inferred.

method.categories: Engine V2: unobserved; prep; output; no-close; close-invalid; validoutsideTop5; top5notTop1; success. First applicable condition wins.
comparison_limits: same pocket source but different pocket geometry
GNINA executable supplies both external modes
V7 penalties and ScorerV1 are not physical E/F measurements
method.joint_validity: Same pose: RMSD <= 2 AND geometric AND chemical.
method.oracle_scope: Successful recorded Engine V2 candidates; 64 slots per prepared case.
method.penalty_decrease: Strict final < initial comparison of recorded binary64 penalties; not physical E/F or measured pre/post RMSD improvement.
method.rss: Sampled descendant RSS may double-count shared pages. Sum of case peaks is not concurrent peak RAM or total memory consumption.
method.timing: Observed engine runtime, excluded diagnostic evaluation, and case wall/CPU are distinct. Missing time is null and excluded; observed preparation-failure zero remains a measurement.
method.unknown_policy: Missing receipt is unobserved, operational non-recovery in the full stage denominator; no engine result is invented.

paired_case_bootstrap.reason: All 32 development cases must have all three verified engine results.
